column4: CREATE TABLE logs (id INT, created_at DATE) PARTITION BY RANGE (YEAR(created_at)) (PARTITION p2023 VALUES LESS THAN (2024), ...);
SELECT * FROM logs WHERE created_at = '2024-01-01'; — awtomatikong tatanggalin ang ibang partitions
mas mabilis ang queries (partition pruning), mas madaling mag-maintain (i-drop ang lumang partition)
ALTER TABLE logs ADD PARTITION (PARTITION p2025 VALUES LESS THAN (2026));
SHOW CREATE TABLE logs; — ipapakita ang partition structure ng table
